summary_cn: 泰国副交通部长披迪蓬·披迪蓓拉西特（Phattrapong Phattraprasit）正加速推进在安达曼地区（Andaman）推出水上飞机服务，以促进旅游业发展和地方经济增长，同时确保航空安全和环保合规。该项目有望成为泰国旅游产业新亮点。
desc_original: Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit is accelerating plans to introduce seaplane services in the Andaman region to boost tourism and the local economy while ensuring aviation safety and protecting the environment.

title: ชงรัฐเร่งปล่อยกู้ซื้อกระบะ ส.อ.ท.สะกิดเตือน! พยุงฐานผลิตก่อนทรุดหนัก
desc: ส.อ.ท.จี้รัฐเร่งปล่อยกู้ซื้อกระบะ พยุงฐานผลิตไทยส่งออกตะวันออกกลางวูบ 37.73% ยอดขายในประเทศยังทรุด ย้ำเป้าผลิตปี 69 ที่ 1.45 ล้านคันไม่เปลี่ยน หวั่นกระทบซัพพลายเชนกว่า 2,500 ราย
title_cn: 工业协会促政府加快皮卡购车贷款 救市产业基础
summary_cn: 泰国工业协会（Federation of Thai Industries, FTI）敦促政府加快发放购皮卡贷款，以支撑国内汽车产业。受中东市场出口暴跌37.73%和国内销售持续低迷拖累，该协会维持2026年产量目标为145万辆，但担忧经济下行可能冲击供应链上2500多家企业。
desc_original: ส.อ.ท.จี้รัฐเร่งปล่อยกู้ซื้อกระบะ พยุงฐานผลิตไทยส่งออกตะวันออกกลางวูบ 37.73% ยอดขายในประเทศยังทรุด ย้ำเป้าผลิตปี 69 ที่ 1.45 ล้านคันไม่เปลี่ยน หวั่นกระทบซัพพลายเชนกว่า 2,500 ราย

title: Push for Thai storage of CCTV footage
desc: The Telecommunications Association of Thailand (TCT) is spearheading a national digital security initiative requiring personal data collected by nationwide closed-circuit TV (CCTV) and Internet of Things (IoT) systems to be stored on local domestic cloud infrastructure.
title_cn: 泰国推进数据本地存储 强化数字安全防护
summary_cn: 泰国电信协会（Telecommunications Association of Thailand, TCT）正推动一项国家数字安全倡议，要求全国闭路电视系统（CCTV）和物联网设备（IoT）收集的个人数据必须存储在本地云基础设施上，以提升国家数据安全和隐私保护水平。
desc_original: The Telecommunications Association of Thailand (TCT) is spearheading a national digital security initiative requiring personal data collected by nationwide closed-circuit TV (CCTV) and Internet of Things (IoT) systems to be stored on local domestic cloud infrastructure.

title: New savings scheme headed to cabinet soon
desc: The Finance Ministry is preparing to promote the Thailand Individual Savings Account (TISA), a long-term savings and investment scheme that offers tax deductions, for cabinet approval later this year.
title_cn: 泰国个人储蓄账户计划年内提交内阁审批
summary_cn: 泰国财政部正准备推行「泰国个人储蓄账户」（Thailand Individual Savings Account, TISA），这是一项长期储蓄和投资计划，参与者可享受税收抵扣优惠。该计划预计在年内提交内阁批准，有助于鼓励国民储蓄和长期投资。
desc_original: The Finance Ministry is preparing to promote the Thailand Individual Savings Account (TISA), a long-term savings and investment scheme that offers tax deductions, for cabinet approval later this year.

title: Ethanol producers welcome slashing of biofuel taxes
desc: The Thai Ethanol Manufacturing Association has welcomed the cabinet's decision to reduce excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel, saying the measure will help to ease living costs, support farmers and strengthen Thailand's energy security.
title_cn: 泰国生物燃料税率下调 乙醇厂商额手相庆
summary_cn: 泰国乙醇制造业协会（Thai Ethanol Manufacturing Association）欢迎政府内阁削减E20汽油和B20生物柴油的消费税决策。该协会认为此举有助于降低民众生活成本、扶持农民收入和增强泰国能源安全与自给能力。
desc_original: The Thai Ethanol Manufacturing Association has welcomed the cabinet's decision to reduce excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel, saying the measure will help to ease living costs, support farmers and strengthen Thailand's energy security.

title: Government, China embassy to clarify travel warning
desc: Chinese arrivals could halve, with the decline extending into next year's Chinese New Year, unless the government clarifies with the Chinese embassy about its warning to mainland citizens about fraudulent job offers and suspected trafficking in the country, warns the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).
title_cn: 政府与中国大使馆澄清旅游预警
summary_cn: 泰国旅游代理商协会（ATTA）警示，中国大使馆已向赴泰游客发布安全警告，涉及非法就业机会和人口贩运风险。若政府未与中国大使馆澄清此警告，中国游客访泰人数恐大幅下降，跌幅预计将延续至2027年春节。这将对高度依赖中国客源的泰国旅游业构成重大威胁。
desc_original: Chinese arrivals could halve, with the decline extending into next year's Chinese New Year, unless the government clarifies with the Chinese embassy about its warning to mainland citizens about fraudulent job offers and suspected trafficking in the country, warns the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).

title: Panel voices concerns on digital trade gap
desc: Thai consumers spent more than 138 billion baht on around 20 foreign digital platforms in the first half of 2026, raising concerns over the country's digital trade deficit and the share of revenue captured by overseas technology companies, says Pawoot Pongvitayapanu, a People's Party list-MP.
title_cn: 泰国数字贸易赤字问题引关注
summary_cn: 泰国消费者在2026年上半年于约20个外国数字平台花费超1380亿泰铢，人民党议员帕武特（Pawoot Pongvitayapanu）指出此举反映国家数字贸易赤字加深。海外科技公司通过这些平台获得巨大收益并流向境外，不利于泰国本地数字产业发展。这一趋势关乎国家长期经济竞争力。
desc_original: Thai consumers spent more than 138 billion baht on around 20 foreign digital platforms in the first half of 2026, raising concerns over the country's digital trade deficit and the share of revenue captured by overseas technology companies, says Pawoot Pongvitayapanu, a People's Party list-MP.

title: Flood victims in Phuket to get payouts
desc: Residents whose homes were damaged by flash floods and landslides in Phuket can qualify for disaster insurance compensation even if flooding lasted less than seven days, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said.
title_cn: 普吉岛水灾受害者获保险赔付
summary_cn: 泰国副内政部长沃拉西特（Worasit Liangprasit）宣布，普吉岛（Phuket）遭受山洪和滑坡灾害的居民，即使灾害持续少于七天，也可申请灾害保险赔偿。此政策调整旨在帮助受灾居民更及时获得经济救济重建家园。这反映了泰国政府对自然灾害防灾减灾工作的重视。
desc_original: Residents whose homes were damaged by flash floods and landslides in Phuket can qualify for disaster insurance compensation even if flooding lasted less than seven days, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said.

title: Taobao adds PromptPay at checkout in local push
desc: Thailand has become the fastest-growing market by user base among all multilingual overseas markets of Alibaba e-commerce arm Taobao Tmall World.
title_cn: 淘宝在泰国推广本地支付方案
summary_cn: 阿里巴巴（Alibaba）旗下淘宝天猫国际推出泰国本地电子支付方式PromptPay，便利泰国消费者线上购物。泰国已成为淘宝所有多语言海外市场中用户增长最快的国家，反映中泰电商合作深化。此举将进一步促进中泰经贸融合，推动泰国数字经济发展。
desc_original: Thailand has become the fastest-growing market by user base among all multilingual overseas markets of Alibaba e-commerce arm Taobao Tmall World.

title: Rangsiman urges DSI to pursue case against Shuffle
desc: People's Party list MP Rangsiman Rome has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to pursue a criminal case against those behind online gambling website Shuffle, saying there is sufficient evidence to proceed.
title_cn: 议员敦促特调局严查在线赌博案
summary_cn: 人民党议员让瑞玛（Rangsiman Rome）敦促泰国特别调查部（DSI）对在线赌博网站Shuffle幕后操纵者提起刑事诉讼，称已有充分证据支持起诉。此案涉及非法网络赌博，关乎泰国法治建设和网络安全监管，打击非法赌博是执法重点。
desc_original: People's Party list MP Rangsiman Rome has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to pursue a criminal case against those behind online gambling website Shuffle, saying there is sufficient evidence to proceed.

title: Cop raids smash mule account ring
desc: Police have arrested 11 suspects in a nationwide crackdown on a transnational network accused of creating and selling corporate mule accounts to scam gangs, money launderers and online gambling operators.
title_cn: 「木偶账户」诈骗网络被摧毁，警方逮捕11人
summary_cn: 泰国警方在全国范围内开展扫黑行动，成功逮捕11名嫌疑人。该跨国犯罪网络专门制造和销售企业「木偶账户」给诈骗团伙、洗钱分子和在线赌博运营商使用。此次行动是打击金融犯罪和网络诈骗的重要举措，有助于切断非法资金流动链条。
desc_original: Police have arrested 11 suspects in a nationwide crackdown on a transnational network accused of creating and selling corporate mule accounts to scam gangs, money launderers and online gambling operators.

title: Houthi attacks 'may imperil Thai Hajj pilgrims', says FM
desc: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said Thailand is closely monitoring the escalating situation in the Middle East, expressing concern for Thai citizens performing the Hajj pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia amid fears the conflict may spread.
title_cn: 外交部长：胡塞武装袭击恐威胁泰国朝觐者安全
summary_cn: 泰国外交部长西哈萨克·彭格经可表示，泰国正密切监测中东日益升级的局势。他对正在沙特阿拉伯进行朝觐的泰国国民表示担忧，担心该地区冲突可能进一步扩大，威胁朝觐者的人身安全。泰国政府已将此列为重点关注事项。
desc_original: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said Thailand is closely monitoring the escalating situation in the Middle East, expressing concern for Thai citizens performing the Hajj pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia amid fears the conflict may spread.

title: Health officials track risks from suspected waste leak
desc: The Public Health Ministry's Department of Disease Control opened an emergency operations centre to monitor health risks after the floods caused a probable leakage from an industrial waste landfill in Prachin Buri province.
title_cn: 北柳府工业废弃物疑泄漏，卫生部门启动应急监测
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部疾病控制部因洪水导致北柳府（Prachin Buri）工业废物填埋场可能泄漏，已启动应急行动中心进行监测。部门正在跟踪相关健康风险，确保公众健康和环境安全。这次泄漏事件涉及工业废物，可能对周边地区造成环境和健康隐患。
desc_original: The Public Health Ministry's Department of Disease Control opened an emergency operations centre to monitor health risks after the floods caused a probable leakage from an industrial waste landfill in Prachin Buri province.

title: PTT eyes cooking oil for fuel production
desc: National oil and gas conglomerate PTT Plc is stepping up efforts to collect used cooking oil (UCO) and upgrade it into biofuels and biopetrochemical products, in a push to build a circular economy and strengthen the country's energy security.
title_cn: PTT 集团开拓废食油回收，构建循环能源经济
summary_cn: 泰国国家油气巨头 PTT 公司正加大力度收集和利用废弃食用油，将其升级为生物燃料和生物化工产品。此举旨在推动循环经济发展，增强泰国能源安全。这一创新举措既有助于环保和资源循环利用，又能推动可再生能源发展，为泰国经济和能源战略转型注入新动力。
desc_original: National oil and gas conglomerate PTT Plc is stepping up efforts to collect used cooking oil (UCO) and upgrade it into biofuels and biopetrochemical products, in a push to build a circular economy and strengthen the country's energy security.

title: Exports, investment offer promise for Thai growth
desc: Tris Rating has upgraded its 2026 Thai GDP growth forecast to 2% from 1.8% and expects growth to reach 2.2% next year, citing stronger private investment and resilient goods exports.
title_cn: 泰国经济增长前景向好，出口和投资成增长引擎
summary_cn: 评级机构 Tris Rating 上调了2026年泰国 GDP 增长预测，从1.8%上调至2%，并预计明年增长将达2.2%。这一预测基于私人投资加强和商品出口持续韧性。专家普遍看好泰国经济复苏，认为出口扩张和投资增加将成为推动国家经济增长的主要动力。
desc_original: Tris Rating has upgraded its 2026 Thai GDP growth forecast to 2% from 1.8% and expects growth to reach 2.2% next year, citing stronger private investment and resilient goods exports.

title: Army says trail resort lacks land-use permit
desc: A trail-running venue and resort in Nakhon Nayok linked to Athip "God" Anantawan, husband of former beauty queen and charity founder Panadda "Bum" Wongphudee, had no military permission to use the land, the army said on Tuesday.
title_cn: 陆军称山地越野度假村缺乏土地使用许可证
summary_cn: 位于那空那育府（Nakhon Nayok）的山地越野跑步场地及度假村与前选美皇后帕娜妲（Panadda）和其丈夫阿蒂普·阿南塔瓦（Athip Anantawan）有关联。泰国陆军周二表示，该度假村缺乏军方批准的土地使用许可证，涉及房产合规与军地管理问题，可能影响设施的进一步运营。
desc_original: A trail-running venue and resort in Nakhon Nayok linked to Athip "God" Anantawan, husband of former beauty queen and charity founder Panadda "Bum" Wongphudee, had no military permission to use the land, the army said on Tuesday.

title: Cabinet approves cheaper fuel prices for 3 months
desc: The cabinet has approved a three-month reduction in excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to help farmers, transport operators, and consumers while boosting demand for agricultural products used in biofuel production, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Tuesday.
title_cn: 泰国内阁批准三个月燃油价格优惠
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准在未来三个月内降低E20汽油和B20生物柴油的消费税。此举旨在帮助农民、运输业者和消费者减轻经济负担，同时刺激生物燃料生产所需农产品的需求。总理阿努廷·查勒姆维拉库尔（Anutin Charnvirakul）周二宣布了这一决定，将直接影响在泰各界的日常交通成本。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved a three-month reduction in excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to help farmers, transport operators, and consumers while boosting demand for agricultural products used in biofuel production, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Tuesday.

desc: Pattaya Bikini Beach Race returns October 31 with Halloween theme Legacy Pattaya is preparing to host a 5 kilometre bikini beach run on Saturday, October 31, with more than 5,000 runners and accompanying visitors from over 30 countries expected to attend the event’s 10th anniversary. title: "ไทยเบฟฯ" คว้ารางวัลชนะเลิศ Most Transparent Company Award
desc: ไทยเบฟ คว้ารางวัลชนะเลิศ Most Transparent Company Award (Big Cap Category) บริษัทที่มีความโปร่งใสมากที่สุด ในกลุ่มบริษัทขนาดใหญ่ตามมูลค่าตลาด จากงาน SIAS Investors’ Choice Awards 2026
title_cn: 泰国饮料集团荣获2026年最佳透明度企业大奖
summary_cn: 泰国饮料公司（Thai Beverage）在2026年SIAS投资者选择奖颁奖典礼上获得「最佳透明度企业奖」（大市值企业类），表彰其在财务披露、信息公开和企业治理方面的卓越表现。SIAS为泰国投资者协会，该奖项旨在表彰上市公司的信息透明度和诚信经营。

title: B35 billion seized from Mauerberger network
desc: Thai authorities have seized and frozen assets worth 35.8 billion baht in their ongoing investigation into an alleged international money-laundering network linked to South African businessman Benjamin Mauerberger and Cambodia-born entrepreneur Yim Leak.
title_cn: 泰国缴获国际洗钱团伙358亿泰铢资产
summary_cn: 泰国执法部门在调查跨国洗钱网络时，查扣并冻结了价值358亿泰铢的资产。该网络与南非商人本杰明·迈尔伯格（Benjamin Mauerberger）和柬埔寨籍企业家叶利（Yim Leak）有关。此案反映了泰国当局在打击国际金融犯罪、防范洗钱方面的执法力度，对维护泰国金融安全和法治环境具有重要意义。
desc_original: Thai authorities have seized and frozen assets worth 35.8 billion baht in their ongoing investigation into an alleged international money-laundering network linked to South African businessman Benjamin Mauerberger and Cambodia-born entrepreneur Yim Leak.

title_cn: 10月28日油价下调：B20柴油降3.69泰铢，汽油降2.19泰铢

title: Defence in Move Forward ethics case to open on Nov 3
desc: The Supreme Court will begin hearing testimony on Nov 3 from defence witnesses in the ethics case brought against 44 former Move Forward Party MPs.
title_cn: 前进党议员伦理案审理将于11月3日开庭
summary_cn: 泰国最高法院将于2026年11月3日开始听取44名前进党（Move Forward Party）前议员的辩方证人证言。该伦理案件涉及该党政治操守及合规性，受到国内外政治观察人士密切关注。此案的审理进展可能对泰国当前政治格局及民主制度产生重要影响，预计将成为近期政坛焦点。

title: Thai food study finds bacteria in raw enoki mushroom samples
desc: Thai food study finds bacteria in raw enoki mushroom samples Legacy Tests conducted by Thailand’s National Food Institute found Listeria bacteria in all five samples of raw enoki mushrooms collected from Bangkok shops . The institute stresses the importance of thoroughly cooking the popular ingredient before eating it. The findings, originally reported in April 2024, involved mushrooms produced domestically and imported from China. Although the small sample does not establish how widespread contamination is, recent overseas recalls show that the food safety risk remains relevant. Enoki mushrooms, known locally as hed khem thong, are widely used in Thai hotpot dishes, shabu-shabu, sukiyaki, stir-fries and grilled foods. The National Food Institute tested five samples purchased from five shops in Bangkok and found Listeria monocytogenes in every sample . The bacterium can cause listeriosis , an infection associated with symptoms including fever, headaches, muscle pain, diarrhoea and vomiting. Most healthy people experience mild symptoms or recover without serious complications. However, older adults, pregnant women and people with weakened immune systems face greater risks. Sev

title: Minister defends Udon Thani Horticultural Expo spending amid budget criticism
desc: Minister defends Udon Thani Horticultural Expo spending amid budget criticism Legacy Thailand’s Deputy Agriculture Minister Watcharaphon Khaokham defended the expected economic benefits of the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 amid questions about spending, with organisers forecasting up to 3.6 million visitors and more than 20 billion baht in additional economic value. The international exhibition is scheduled to run from November 1 to March 14, 2027, at the Nong Dae wetland in Kut Sa subdistrict, Mueang Udon Thani district. The programme will feature horticultural displays, agricultural technology and activities that change throughout the event. Watcharaphon said the site was about 90% complete when he visited roughly two weeks ago. He was due to conduct a final inspection on October 30, ahead of the opening. Watcharaphon said estimates from private-sector organisations, including the Thai Chamber of Commerce and the Federation of Thai Industries, indicated that the event could benefit hotels, restaurants, transport operators and other businesses. He added that accommodation was reportedly fully booked as far away as Nong Khai. Photo via Facebook/ พืชสวนโลกอุดรธานี

title: Endangered red panda found hidden in pickup truck in Tak
desc: Endangered red panda found hidden in pickup truck in Tak Legacy A red panda was found on October 23 hidden inside a pickup truck in Tak province, with the protected animal now set to receive care at Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Chon Buri. Mae Sot police discovered the protected animal at approximately 7.30pm after stopping a suspicious pickup truck at a checkpoint in Tha Sai Luat subdistrict, Mae Sot district. Police found the red panda inside the vehicle and seized it after the two suspects failed to produce valid ownership or import documents for the animal. Both face legal proceedings, while the animal was transferred to the Mae Sot Wildlife Checkpoint for care on October 24. An initial veterinary examination found that the red panda was frightened and exhausted but had no serious external injuries. It is currently undergoing quarantine, close monitoring and nutritional rehabilitation.
